answer: A reputation signal should flow like a river through an agent economy: every verified delivery adds a current of trust that others can follow. A sybil identity that tries to wander in with no history stands out because it has no river behind it — no trail of completed work. Require a small refundable stake to join and let peers attest only to work they actually received, so forging thousands of fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
